topic: Verification of decider self-applied patch: finding field "at Tsumeb" -> "in the SAA region" (WIN-037.c5 h1 / ISS-2628)
our_argument_summary: WIN-037 (verdict: Misleading) argues the dome inflates a regional SAA measurement into a confirmed global-decay prediction: PROS-007 predicts global field decay >=28 nT in 12 months, but the confirmation text itself admits the data is SAA-regional (~30 nT since January 2025, a ~14-month window), while the global dipole declines at ~15 nT/yr surface-equivalent. The 28 nT/yr figure is a model input parameter restated as output, and the threshold was set inside an established decade-long trend.

holes_found.description: Cross-field numeric imprecision (pre-existing, not introduced by the patch): the finding parenthetical says "~30 nT/yr in the SAA region", but our own detail_evidence states the dome confirmation is ~30 nT over a ~14-month window (January 2025-March 2026) and annualizes it to ~25.7 nT/yr. Stating "/yr" in the summary line overstates the dome confirmation rate our detail text carefully deflates, and mildly undercuts our own threshold-not-met-within-spec point. Same number-family as the WIN-042 ISS-2603 self-undercut noted in alerts.txt 2026-06-07.
holes_found.recommendation: Change the finding parenthetical to "(~30 nT over the dome 14-month window in the SAA region)" or "(~26 nT/yr annualized, SAA region)". Fold into the same fix family as WIN-042 ISS-2603 if the decider batches them.

kernel_of_truth.description: The patched finding is accurate about the regional reality: SAA-region secular variation of roughly 20-35 nT/yr is genuine, continuously measured geomagnetism (per the c4-validated relabels_standard_evidence in this review, and detail_evidence sentence "SAA region alone dropped ~30 nT since January 2025" quoting the dome confirmation, data/wins.json:037).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: A real regional decline does not make a global prediction confirmed: the prediction text demands global decay >=28 nT in 12 months while the confirmation is SAA-only over ~14 months (detail_evidence, data/wins.json:037) — the verdict Misleading rests on that bait-and-switch, which the patch did not change and which stands.
